text: DSH Custom Auto Review 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的工具调用审查插件。它为 Auto 权限模式接入独立配置的模型审查路由，并提供设置工具和设置界面。审查原生工具调用及已启动的 PTC 内部调用，允许后继续原有流程，拒绝时按审批策略处理；可配置供应商、模型、推理强度和超时。适合希望为 DSH Auto 模式选择独立审查模型的用户。需要预先在 DSH 配置模型供应商和模型。

DSH Custom Auto Review adds a separate model reviewer for tool calls in DSH Web Auto mode. It reviews native and started PTC calls before execution. A settings tool and UI let users choose a configured provider, model, reasoning effort, and timeout.

Use a separate model to review DSH tool calls before execution.
Configure a dedicated reviewer route for Auto mode in DSH.
DSH Custom Auto Review 的功能「工具调用前的模型审查」：原生工具调用和已启动的 PTC 内部调用会在工具主体运行前送入审查流程；仅在 Auto 权限模式启用该门禁。
DSH Custom Auto Review 的功能「独立审查路由配置」：在设置中选择已注册的供应商、模型、可选推理强度和超时；配置不会继承主模型路由。
DSH Custom Auto Review 的功能「设置工具读取与保存」：auto_review_settings 工具支持读取当前设置、查询模型目录以及按版本号保存审查设置。
DSH Custom Auto Review 的功能「Web 设置界面」：宿主设置服务向 Web 界面提供配置读取、保存和供应商模型目录查询。
DSH Custom Auto Review 使用所选审查模型处理工作目录、项目指令、筛选后的会话历史及待审工具调用信息；审查请求内容由已选模型供应商处理。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Introduction：DSH-Custom-Auto-Review adds a configurable review gate for DSH tool calls. The reviewer route is selected independently from the main model route. The review request still contains session and tool-call information, so a separate route does not create an isolated context or a privacy boundary.

Package: `@local/dsh-custom-auto-review@0.3.0`. Install a versioned `.tgz` from this repository's GitHub Releases. The package is not published as an npm registry package.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · What it does：- Uses a user-selected, already configured DSH model provider and model for review.
- Reviews supported native tool calls and started PTC inner calls before their tool bodies run.
- Fails closed when review cannot complete; it does not fall back to the main model.
- Keeps review-model settings separate from the main-model selection.

Model-based review is probabilistic. It is not a security guarantee and must not replace DSH permission controls or human review for sensitive operations.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Compatibility：| DSH version | Support status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.1` | In the tested compatibility scope |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | In the tested compatibility scope; primary target for this maintenance round |
| Other versions | Not verified; no compatibility claim |

The package requires Node.js `>=24`. The automated suite passed 134 tests on each of `0.2.1-rc.1` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. These results do not establish GUI interaction or live-provider acceptance, which require user confirmation.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Install or roll back：Use one release artifact at a time. Follow the selected release's migration notes and verify the active review provider before enabling Auto.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Configure the reviewer：1. Configure a model provider in DSH first. This plugin does not include a model service or supply model access.
2. Open the plugin's settings form. The initial reviewer route is empty; choose a registered provider and model, then select a reasoning effort supported by that model when available.
3. Save the reviewer settings explicitly. Saving does not change the main model and does not select or enable Auto.
4. Select Auto separately only after checking the route, review behavior, and permission policy.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Configure the reviewer：The plugin never silently inherits or falls back to the main model. Without a valid reviewer route, review is unavailable and tool execution remains blocked by the gate. There is no free-model or hosted-service promise.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Privacy and safety：For a review request, the plugin sends the selected reviewer the working directory, project instructions, filtered session history, and the pending tool-call details needed for the decision. These inputs can contain private project information. Review-route separation is a configuration choice, not context isolation or data redaction. Use a provider approved for the data in the session, and do not include secrets in test prompts or public examples.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Privacy and safety：A reviewer denial can still be subject to DSH's configured human-approval policy. A failed, timed-out, cancelled, or invalid review does not authorize the pending tool body. Keep DSH permission guards enabled and treat model output as fallible.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Development：The following commands are the repository's current development scripts. `npm run link:runtime` links the exact DSH APIs used by the test harness; it does not install another runtime. See [maintenance policy](docs/MAINTENANCE.md) for the version-specific checks and release process.

```sh
npm run link:runtime
npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix tools/gui/build-tools
npm run build:gui
npm run check

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Development：Do not use a live model gateway as a routine test target. Live-provider checks require explicit authorization and must use synthetic, non-sensitive input.

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · Introduction：DSH-Custom-Auto-Review 为 DSH 工具调用增加可配置的审查门禁。审查路由与主模型路由分别设置，但审查请求仍包含会话和工具调用信息。独立配置不等于上下文隔离，也不构成隐私边界。

包名：`@local/dsh-custom-auto-review@0.3.0`。请从本仓库的 GitHub Releases 下载按版本固定的 `.tgz`。该包不作为 npm registry 包发布。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · 功能：- 使用用户在 DSH 中已配置的模型供应商和模型执行审查。
- 在工具主体运行前审查受支持的原生工具调用和已启动的 PTC 内部调用。
- 审查无法完成时 fail-closed，不回落到主模型。
- 审查模型设置与主模型选择保持分离。

模型审查具有概率性，不构成安全保证，也不能替代 DSH 权限控制或敏感操作的人为审核。

| `0.2.1-rc.2` | 属于已测试的兼容范围；本轮维护以此版本为主要验收目标 |

包要求 Node.js `>=24`。自动化测试套件在 `0.2.1-rc.1` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上均通过 134 项测试。测试结果不能证明 GUI 交互或实时模型服务验收通过，这两项仍需用户确认。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · 安装或回滚：1. 打开 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/QR-0W/DSH-Custom-Auto-Review/releases)，选择确切的发布 tag。
2. 下载该 release 附带的 `.tgz`，通过 DSH Plugin Manager 安装本地归档。核对已安装的包版本，并按管理器显示的结果继续。
3. 回滚时，选择先前的 release tag，再通过同一管理器安装对应 `.tgz`。不要安装浮动或未固定版本的包。

每次只使用一个 release 归档。按所选 release 的迁移说明操作，并在启用 Auto 前检查当前审查路由。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · 配置审查模型：1. 先在 DSH 中配置模型供应商。本插件不包含模型服务，也不提供模型访问权限。
2. 打开插件设置表单。初始审查路由为空；选择已注册的供应商和模型。模型提供推理强度选项时，只能选择该模型支持的值。
3. 显式保存审查设置。保存不会更改主模型，也不会选择或自动启用 Auto。
4. 核对路由、审查行为和权限策略后，再单独选择 Auto。

插件不会静默继承主模型，也不会回落到主模型。没有有效审查路由时，审查不可用，门禁不会放行工具执行。本项目不承诺免费模型或托管服务。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · 隐私与安全：每次审查请求会向所选审查模型提交工作目录、项目指令、筛选后的会话历史，以及完成判断所需的待执行工具调用信息。这些输入可能含有私有项目数据。审查路由分开配置只代表路由选择不同，不会隔离上下文或自动脱敏。请使用获准处理当前会话数据的模型服务，不要在测试提示或公开示例中放入密钥。

审查模型拒绝调用后，DSH 的人工审批策略仍可决定是否继续询问用户。审查失败、超时、取消或输出无效时，不会授权待执行工具主体。保持 DSH 权限防护，并将模型输出视为可能出错的判断。

@local/dsh-custom-auto-review README · 开发：以下命令来自仓库现有开发脚本。`npm run link:runtime` 会链接测试所用的精确 DSH API，不会安装第二套运行时。版本检查和发布流程见[维护政策](docs/MAINTENANCE.md)。

```sh
npm run link:runtime
npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix tools/gui/build-tools
npm run build:gui
npm run check

不要把真实模型网关作为常规测试目标。实时服务检查需要明确授权，并且只能使用合成的非敏感输入。
